before_roles.title: One useful journey in eight hours
before_roles.intro: Build Pollution Spotter as a four-person MVP during the official 10:00-18:00 IST hacking window at IEM, GN Block, Sector V, Kolkata. This pack describes future work; the application has not been built.

blocks.heading: Start with the verified event brief
blocks.text: Read [docs/AKI_HACKS_EVENT_BRIEF.md](docs/AKI_HACKS_EVENT_BRIEF.md) and the [official event page](https://events.mlh.com/events/15462-hacktoberfest-hack-day-kolkata-x-aki-hacks). Detailed registration is 08:00-10:00 and judging is 18:00-20:00. The header/calendar says 09:00 start; confirm arrival with the organizers.

blocks.heading: Four role slots; people choose their roles
rows: M2 request fields; M4 map slot
Shared contracts and API for all
Public map, gates, phone QA, demo

blocks.heading: Required MVP acceptance
items: A user uploads one supported photo and confirms a location; a private draft is persisted.
Gemini suggests visible labels, or the draft clearly uses manual review. A person edits and explicitly confirms before publication.
Published data survives refresh, appears on a public map and generates an editable complaint the user can copy.
Private photos remain private; source/sample labels are visible; failed saving is never presented as success.

blocks.heading: Existing repository; no assumed assignments
blocks.text: The private repository is https://github.com/Godavenger/pollution-spotter. Sangeeta2006451 has write access; Shivi3123 and deeparkai32109-alt have pending write invitations. Godavenger is the admin. M1-M4 mappings are unassigned. There are 24 unchecked implementation tasks.

before_roles.title: Build only the path to one report
before_roles.intro: Keep the familiar stack, but reduce what it must do. Create the scaffold during the permitted coding window; pre-event coding permission is not established.

blocks.heading: Proposed components
rows: One phone-friendly upload/review/map page; Next.js server routes own writes.
Postgres reports, private report-photos bucket, anonymous session ownership; no signup UI.
Server-only visual suggestion; exact available model ID verified at H1.
Client-only pins and visible attribution; no density or hotspot computation.
HTTPS preview at H1, deployed core by H5 and frozen URL at H7.

blocks.heading: One end-to-end sequence
items: 1. M1 gets an anonymous session, accepts a JPEG/PNG/WebP <=3 MB and collects editable coordinates or a pin.
2. M2 verifies the token, decodes and strips image metadata, stores the photo privately and persists a needs_review draft.
3. M3 returns a validated visual suggestion within 12 seconds; failure leaves an editable unclear/manual_fallback result.
4. M1 requires review of labels, short description and location; M2 publishes the same row after owner and input checks.
5. M4 refreshes published pins after confirmation; M1 builds a local complaint draft with Copy and manual text selection.

blocks.heading: Deliberately deferred
blocks.text: No hotspots, background polling, 20-image evaluation, photo gallery, client compression, private notes, complaint download/persistence, resumable uploads, automatic sending, elaborate accounts or broad production hardening. Larger photos get a clear size error. Post-event work has no assumed event-time extension.

before_roles.title: Small contracts protect integration
before_roles.intro: M2 owns lib/contracts.ts. All roles agree the payload examples by 11:00. The following are proposed implementation contracts, not existing endpoints.

blocks.heading: Three routes
rows: Bearer session token; multipart image, latitude, longitude. Save a private needs_review draft and return its id, labels, evidence, source and is_demo. A storage/database failure is an error.
Bearer token; action=publish, labels, evidence, latitude, longitude. Verify owner, stored image and explicit review; update the same row; preserve first published_at.
Public read of published rows only. Default real view; a separate sample view selects is_demo=true. Return only the allowlist below.

blocks.heading: Labels and vision boundary
blocks.text: Label = algal_bloom | oil_sheen | garbage | no_visible_pollution | unclear. Pollution labels may co-occur; either neutral label must stand alone. Validate nonempty unique allowed labels, evidence <=240 characters, finite latitude [-90,90] and longitude [-180,180]. VisionResult = {labels, evidence, review_needed:boolean}; analyzeImage({bytes:Buffer,mimeType:string}): Promise<VisionResult>. Every result needs human review.

blocks.heading: Private record
blocks.text: id, owner_id, created_at, published_at, latitude, longitude, image_path, labels, evidence, analysis_source, status, is_demo. Status is needs_review or published. analysis_source is vision, manual_fallback or mock; the browser cannot set it or is_demo. Mock mode sets is_demo=true at draft creation. Store normalized images at reports/{id}.jpg in the private bucket.

blocks.heading: Exact public field allowlist
blocks.text:
id, published_at, latitude, longitude,
labels, evidence, analysis_source, is_demo

blocks.heading: Minimum integrity and privacy
blocks.text: Verify the token server-side and match owner_id on every write. Deny direct report/storage access for both anon and authenticated client roles; keep service keys server-only. Public photos are out of scope. Disable double submission and do not auto-retry draft creation; publish is repeat-safe on the same row. A late analysis result must never edit a published report.

before_roles.title: Five gates, one eight-hour build
before_roles.intro: H0 is 10:00 on Saturday 31 October 2026. These are elapsed event hours, not extra estimates per task. Workstreams run in parallel and integrate early.

blocks.heading: Required gate schedule
rows: Contracts, fixtures and file ownership agreed; HTTPS preview, auth/storage and model access have recorded outcomes.
Upload -> persisted private draft -> manual/sample review -> publish -> refreshed map. Identify simulated parts explicitly.
Full persisted journey plus complaint Copy; use live vision if working, otherwise lock clearly labeled manual mode.
Phone/privacy checks recorded, release commit fixed, demo script and backup prepared.
Rehearsed truthful demonstration ready for the announced submission and judging process.

blocks.heading: Use the deadline to cut scope
items: If an interface drifts, pause polish and fix that boundary together. M4 records one next action and owner for each blocker.
If vision access fails, continue the complete manual-review workflow. Do not spend the day switching providers.
If auth/storage cannot be made safe, disable publishing and show a labeled prototype or recorded backup; disclose that the full MVP is incomplete.
After H5, add no features. H5-H7 is for core failures and required checks; H7-H8 is for freeze, evidence and rehearsal.

blocks.heading: Before the event
blocks.text: Use the time for planning, registration, learning and confirming organizer instructions. Rules for code prepared before the event are unknown. The selection PPT is a proposal; update claims only when the application and its results have actually been verified.

after_roles.title: Track work in four GitHub Issues
after_roles.intro: The repository exists. The workstream Issue bodies in this pack are ready to use; the repository currently has no Issues, and role assignments are unconfirmed. Follow docs/GITHUB_SETUP.md for the current setup steps.

blocks.heading: Set up without adding ceremony
items: Agree who fills M1-M4. Invitations alone do not assign a workstream; leave the role clearly unassigned until the person confirms.
Create one Issue per file in github-issues/member-1.md through member-4.md, then paste actual Issue URLs into GITHUB_TRACKER.md.
Each role follows six tasks in order. Use small branches and reviewed PRs; M2 owns shared contracts and dependency changes.
Use Refs #issue for partial work. Close a workstream only after every required Done condition is verified; do not close it merely because the clock ran out.

blocks.heading: Evidence comment to copy
blocks.text:
Task ID: M?-??
Change and PR/commit:
Check performed and observed result:
Mode: live / manual_fallback / sample/mock
Reviewer and downstream handoff:
Remaining blocker or limitation:

blocks.heading: Where truth lives
rows: An authorized editor checks a box after evidence; use this as the live record.
Requires editing and committing the file; it does not sync with Issue boxes.
Boxes are for manual use; they do not update GitHub.
Describes a proposed project. A concept flow is not a completed demo.

blocks.heading: Six tasks per role, 24 total
blocks.text: Unchecked tasks are future work. The planning pack's PDF/layout validation does not test the application, and collaborator invitations do not prove acceptance or role assignment.

after_roles.title: Conservative suggestions, useful output
after_roles.intro: Keep visible evidence separate from environmental measurement. A photo can support a visual observation; it cannot establish pollutant chemistry or whether water is safe.

blocks.heading: Starter vision prompt
blocks.text:
Inspect visible water-surface clues only.
Allowed labels: algal_bloom, oil_sheen, garbage,
no_visible_pollution, unclear.
Use unclear when the image does not support a label.
Neutral labels must be exclusive; avoid duplicate labels.
Return labels, brief evidence and review_needed.
No toxin, drinking-safety or confidence-percentage claims.
Human confirmation is required before publication.

blocks.heading: Six smoke cases; no accuracy claim
blocks.text: M3 uses consented/licensed images for litter, green surface, sheen-like surface, clean/glare, blur and mixed/ambiguous content. Record provenance, expected cues, actual output and analysis_source. Record timeouts and invalid outputs as failures; manual/mock results are not successful AI predictions. This is a functional smoke check, not a model benchmark.

blocks.heading: Pins-only public view
blocks.text: Show confirmed labels, reviewed description, time, coordinates and source. Refresh on load, after publish and on Refresh. Real reports are the default; samples appear only in a separate visibly labeled view. Show OpenStreetMap attribution. Do not infer hotspots, independent observations or environmental danger from report counts.

blocks.heading: Editable complaint template; Copy only
User controls the complaint
blocks.text: The user edits and copies the text, checks the recipient and sends it separately. Do not claim a municipal integration, automatic delivery or resolution. If clipboard access fails, keep the text selectable for manual copying.

after_roles.title: Verify the core, then freeze
after_roles.intro: Run a compact set of meaningful integration checks on the deployed URL. Record observed results; leave a failed or unrun check explicit. This matrix is a plan, not evidence that the checks have passed.

blocks.heading: Small acceptance matrix
rows: Supported photo -> review -> publish -> refresh -> one visible map report -> complaint Copy.
A second anonymous session cannot publish/edit the first session's draft.
Private drafts and photos are inaccessible publicly; GET contains only the published-field allowlist.
Unsupported/large image, missing stored image or database failure cannot create a false published success.
Timeout/invalid output becomes unclear/manual_fallback; human review can finish the saved draft.
Nothing publishes automatically; repeated publish uses the same row and first publication time.
Mock starts as is_demo=true and remains so; real and sample map views are visibly separate.
Final HTTPS phone journey is usable with denied GPS/manual coordinates; build/type checks pass.

blocks.heading: Release evidence
items: At H3, record the first integrated persisted flow and any mocked pieces. At H5, record the chosen live/manual mode.
At H7, save the deployed commit, URL, phone/browser, actual checks and known limitations in docs/demo.md.
Use consented or licensed demo photos and avoid personal information in the public description or selected location.

blocks.heading: Minimum protections remain required
blocks.text: A private controlled hackathon demo still needs ownership checks, private storage and honest status. Rate limiting, abuse handling, retention/deletion workflows and wider operational hardening are post-event work before a public service launch.

after_roles.title: Make failure a clear state
after_roles.intro: M2 owns environment configuration. Never commit keys or paste private image data into logs. M3 selects the exact model ID that is available in the team's account.

blocks.heading: Names-only .env.example
blocks.text:
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=
GEMINI_API_KEY=
GEMINI_MODEL=
VISION_MODE=live

blocks.heading: Three deliberate vision modes
blocks.text: VISION_MODE=live calls Gemini; manual skips the provider and uses analysis_source=manual_fallback; mock uses deterministic suggestions and analysis_source=mock with is_demo=true from the start. Keep service and Gemini keys server-only. Next.js server routes use the Node runtime for image normalization.

blocks.heading: Recovery that fits the event
rows: Use manual mode at H5 if needed. Explain that the person classified the visible issue; no live AI success claim.
Stop public writes; fix access if possible. Otherwise show a labeled prototype/backup and name the missing persistence.
Ask for a supported photo <=3 MB; allow coordinates or pin correction without GPS.
Keep report details and coordinates visible; show the map failure and a labeled backup if needed.
Use a recorded run or screenshots labeled as recorded; do not describe it as a live submission.
Disable duplicate actions, avoid automatic POST retries and do not guess success; publish only the returned saved draft ID.

blocks.heading: Setup is part of the eight hours
blocks.text: Follow [docs/APP_SETUP.md](docs/APP_SETUP.md) for starter commands and ownership. At H1, record service access and the preview outcome. A failing hello-world deploy or private-storage check is a core blocker, not a reason to claim a mock is complete software.

after_roles.title: Show one report clearly
after_roles.intro: The official template is a six-slide selection presentation. The following three-minute script is a team rehearsal target, not a published organizer time limit. Adapt to the final instructions.

blocks.heading: Suggested rehearsal
rows: People need a clear way to document a visible water-surface issue; usefulness remains to be tested.
Use one consented photo. State whether this run is live, manual or sample.
The suggestion can be wrong. A person confirms the public fields; the photo remains private.
Show persistence and the pin. Samples stay separate; no hotspot or water-safety claim.
The user checks wording and recipient, then sends separately.
Name actual checks, what is still incomplete and the next useful improvement.

blocks.heading: Final readiness at 18:00
items: Freeze the commit and final URL by H7; rehearse once with every presenter clear about their part.
Keep a labeled recording/screenshots and sourced images ready. Do not conceal manual review or mock results.
Use the official PPT template and fill verified team details before submission; roles remain planning slots until agreed.
Follow organizer submission rules. The pack does not register the team, submit the PPT or prove selection.

blocks.heading: After the event, if the core works
blocks.text: Consider user feedback, a larger independent evaluation, careful report-density visualization, access/abuse controls and photo sharing only after privacy review. Gemini usage alone does not establish Gemma 4 or open-weight challenge eligibility.
